stem: How did the Brown v. Board of Education ruling affect the Civil Rights Movement?

options.label: A
options.text: The ruling led to increased segregation that targeted a select group of citizens.

options.label: B
options.text: The ruling repealed laws that had previously protected the policy of segregation.

options.label: C
options.text: The ruling resulted in racial equality for all minority citizens living in the country.

options.label: D
options.text: The ruling prevented other minority groups from protesting for equal treatment.
